# API Compatibility and Provider Neutrality Checklist: Plugin-Supplied Sample Resource for Conformance

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of API compatibility and provider neutrality for PR review
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only
when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not
mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all entry points that need the sample resource enumerated (level runners, plugin SDK wrappers,
  `NewConformanceSuiteWithConfig`, `RunCategory`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the registered checks that must use the sample resource listed by name, so none can be missed?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behavior of each standalone runner (`RunSpecValidation`, `RunPerformanceBenchmarks`,
  `RunConcurrencyTests`, `RunRPCCorrectness`) stated as a single choice rather than "either/or"? [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec state which checks deliberately keep sending no descriptor (nil-resource check) so the
  "every check" wording does not cover them? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the components explicitly left unchanged (`ErrorHandlingTestSuite`, `contract.go` validator tests)
  recorded with a reason? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "without breaking any existing call" defined precisely enough to cover stored function values, not
  only direct calls? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the default descriptor specified by exact field values rather than by reference to current code?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "invalid sample resource" defined by the existing contract rules, and is the error content (which
  field) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the copy semantics requirement stated for both the author's instance and per-check instances?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Is FR-006 (bare actual-cost request replaced) consistent with FR-007 (accepted codes unchanged)?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Do SC-001's failure counts match the verified reproduction in Clarifications? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the Basic/Standard level of the actual-cost checks stated consistently between User Story 3 and the
  Clarifications? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the plan's API (new `RunConformance` plus options) satisfy FR-002 without contradicting the issue's
  suggested variadic form, and is the deviation justified? [Consistency, Research §R1]

## Provider Neutrality

- [ ] CHK014 Is the neutrality constraint stated as a requirement (not only an assumption) with a measurable outcome?
  [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the only permitted non-neutral content (the `aws` default) bounded and justified as
  compatibility-only? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified that downstream plugin measurements stay out of code, tests, and docs? [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the neutral provider choice (`custom`) shown to be valid under existing contract rules without
  changing the provider list? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Does SC-005 define which files are in scope for the provider-name count, so the existing provider list in
  unchanged files does not trigger it? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Is the neutral reference plugin's behavior (which RPCs reject, with which code) specified enough to make
  FR-009 reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "the Basic level fails without a sample resource" kept as an acceptance guard so the defect cannot
  silently return? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK021 Are documentation acceptance criteria measurable (which three documents, example compiles)?
  [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §SC-006]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are latency checks required to exclude descriptor copying from timings? [Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK023 Is concurrent use of the shared descriptor across goroutines addressed? [Coverage, Research §R4]

## Notes

- Items are unchecked by design; the reviewer marks them. `/speckit-implement` reads this file but does
  not change its markers.
